tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search Indian degree, diploma and online courses on CareerBhavan (e.g. "online MBA", "BCA", "data science"). Returns course slugs, level, duration, mode and fee range. Use get_course_details next for syllabus, eligibility and colleges offering it.

tools.name: search_colleges
tools.description: Find Indian colleges and universities (including online and distance universities) on CareerBhavan. Filter by name, a course they offer, city, institution type, and total-fee budget in INR. Returns slugs, location, NAAC/NIRF, approvals and fees.

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Full public details of one course: eligibility, entrance exams, duration, fee range, syllabus by semester, career outcomes with salary ranges, FAQs, specialisations and colleges offering it with their fees.

tools.name: get_college_details
tools.description: Full public profile of one college or university: approvals (UGC, AICTE, NAAC…), NIRF rank, rating, fees, placements, courses offered with fees, student review excerpts and FAQs.

tools.name: get_college_course_details
tools.description: Details of one course at one college (e.g. Online MBA at a specific university): fees and fee breakdown, duration, mode, eligibility, admission notes, syllabus and FAQs.

tools.name: compare_colleges
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–4 colleges: type, location, approvals, NAAC, NIRF, rating, fees and placements. Pass course_slug to compare the fees, duration and mode of that specific course at each college.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search CareerBhavan counsellor-written guides and articles (admissions, fees, online degree validity, careers). Returns titles, short excerpts and links.
